notes.title: A small but important update for your comfort 😊
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it’s time for the first update that will make the game even more enjoyable:

Optimization — the game now runs smoother and more stable.

Gamepad support is back.

Steam Deck support has returned.

Fixed minor bugs so nothing distracts from the atmosphere.

Thank you for spending time in our game. Your feedback helps us make it even cozier.
With love, Faraway Home ❤️

notes.title: A Cozy Haven Amid Autumn Storms. Release on September 18, 2025
notes.notes:
🍂 This autumn is rich with big premieres: nimble heroines with needles, endless firefights over piles of loot, dark cities where nightmares hide, and long-awaited returns to beloved worlds. The season promises to be bright, loud, and full of challenges.



But amidst all this noise, it’s so important to have a quiet place to come back to.
Dragon Spot is exactly that place.
A game like your favorite blanket: warm, soft, and always there. Your pause. Your cozy island in the middle of autumn storms.

Created by just two people with a lot of love, it became our little world — one we can’t wait to share with you.



📅 On September 18, 2025, the game will launch on Steam, and we’re looking forward with great excitement to the moment when you can step into our world.

Thank you for being with us. It means so much to us.
With love, Faraway Home 💖



📝 P.S. The playtest will end on September 12 — thank you to everyone helping us make the game even better.

notes.title: Update 0.2a: More Control, Possibilities, and Much More
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are thrilled to present the next big update — 0.2a !
It adds new tools for Creative Mode, enhances controls, and makes the game even easier to use. Watch the timelapse video below to see all the changes in action!

[previewyoutube=_sMS8musLww;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new in Update 0.2a?

 Time of Day Settings: You can now change the time of day on your island. Create cozy sunsets or bright sunrises!
 Undo/Redo System (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y): Easily fix mistakes or experiment with designs. This also helps record stunning timelapses!
 Improved Camera Controls: The new system allows you to explore every corner of your island in detail.
 Experimental Steam Deck and Gamepad Support: Dragon Spot is now playable not only on PC but also on portable devices!
 Video Tutorials: We’ve added detailed video guides to help newcomers get started faster.
 Simplified Puzzle Mode: Building islands from blueprints has become much easier thanks to new mechanics.
 Bug Fixes: The game is now more stable and enjoyable than ever.


This update brings even more convenience and excitement. With the day/night system, you can create unique atmospheres, easily undo mistakes, and even play on Steam Deck or with a gamepad.

Thank you for your support 💖
We sincerely appreciate your feedback and attention to the game. Thanks to you, Dragon Spot keeps getting better with each update! Share your impressions — we carefully read every message.

More information about the playtest:

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Second Step. Update 0.10d: Creative Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  
We’re thrilled to announce a major update and the next step in our open playtest!  

This time, we’ve introduced a Creative Mode that opens up endless possibilities. Create unique islands, place objects however you like, and build your own world! We’ve also added support for MacBooks on Apple Silicon, so even more players can join our community.  

https://i.imgur.com/q9xTzRS.gif

What’s new in this update?  
  
 Creative Mode: design and shape your islands as you wish.  
 Cross-platform saves for Creative Mode.  
 Steam Cloud support (cross-platform saves).  
 A level selection menu for easier navigation.  
 New decorations for human villagers to make their homes cozier.  
 House editor: now you can repaint and customize human buildings.  
 New models of trees, bushes, and other greenery.  
 Updated house models with more details.  
 New types of windows, doors, and stoves for added variety.  
 New activities for dragons to keep them entertained.  
  
https://i.imgur.com/deMO24X.gif

Thank you for your support!  
We sincerely appreciate your feedback and dedication to the game. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update! Share your thoughts—we read every message.
